boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten current, documented no-admission activities at Union College and nearby Schenectady sites.

cards.title: Browse Mandeville Gallery
cards.subtitle: Nott Memorial, Union College
cards.notes: Meet upstairs in the Nott Memorial, move through the current exhibition together, and use one artwork as a prompt for a low-key conversation.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day-a-week, public art stop inside Union’s Nott Memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: Union states that Mandeville Gallery is on the Nott Memorial’s second floor and is free and open to the public seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Union Staff Resources | Schaffer Library | Union College
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public seven days a week, per Union; check the gallery’s current exhibition details before going.

cards.title: Take the Hervé Koubi master class
cards.subtitle: Henle Dance Pavilion, Union College — Oct. 16
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the 5 p.m. master class, arrive ready to move, and confirm any participation guidance with the Theater and Dance department.
cards.short_summary: A free public dance master class during Union’s Stephanie C. Davis Dance Residency.
cards.evidence_claim: Union lists a 5–6:15 p.m. Compagnie Hervé KOUBI master class in Henle Dance Pavilion on Oct. 16, 2026, and says both on-campus events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Season | Theater & Dance | Union College
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Friday, Oct. 16, 2026, 5–6:15 p.m.; Union says it is free and open to the public.

cards.title: Catch the Hervé Koubi demo
cards.subtitle: Henle Dance Pavilion, Union College — Oct. 16
cards.notes: Stay or return for the 6:30 p.m. lecture-demonstration, then compare notes on the movement, capoeira, and urban-dance elements described by Union.
cards.short_summary: A free public artist lecture-demonstration following the residency master class.
cards.evidence_claim: Union lists a 6:30–7:30 p.m. Compagnie Hervé KOUBI lecture/demonstration in Henle Dance Pavilion on Oct. 16, 2026, and says both events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Season | Theater & Dance | Union College
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Friday, Oct. 16, 2026, 6:30–7:30 p.m.; Union says it is free and open to the public.

cards.entity_name: The First Adirondackers: 12,000 Years of Indigenous Peoples in the ADK Uplands
cards.title: Hear “The First Adirondackers”
cards.subtitle: Old Chapel, Union College — Sept. 18
cards.notes: Register for this one-time Old Chapel presentation, then linger with friends to discuss the archaeology, natural science, and oral-history perspectives.
cards.short_summary: A free public talk on 12,000 years of Indigenous presence in the Adirondack uplands.
cards.evidence_claim: Union’s UCALL page lists this Sept. 18, 2026 Old Chapel event as free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Courses and Registration | UCALL | Union College
cards.access_notes: Friday, Sept. 18, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. in Old Chapel; the listing says free and open to all and provides registration.

cards.entity_name: Civic Engagement and Volunteerism: Making an Impact in Your Community
cards.title: Join the civic-engagement session
cards.subtitle: College Park Hall Ballroom, Union College — Sept. 28
cards.notes: Register for the session and go with a friend; use its local-government, citizen-science, nonprofit, and political-service examples to compare next steps.
cards.short_summary: A free public session about finding manageable local service pathways.
cards.evidence_claim: Union’s UCALL page lists this Sept. 28, 2026 College Park Hall Ballroom session as free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Courses and Registration | UCALL | Union College
cards.access_notes: Monday, Sept. 28, 2026, 9:30–11:30 a.m.; the listing says free and open to all and provides registration.

cards.entity_name: Schenectady County Outdoor Summer Movie Night at River Road Park
cards.title: Bring a blanket to River Road Park
cards.subtitle: River Road Park, Niskayuna — Aug. 19
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or lawn chair, meet at the park before the screening, and settle in for a no-ticket outdoor movie night with friends.
cards.short_summary: One of Schenectady County’s four free August outdoor movie nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Schenectady County says its August movie nights are free and include a screening at River Road Park in Niskayuna.
cards.source_title: Schenectady County Announces Lineup of Free and Family-Friendly Events for Summer Break
cards.access_notes: Listed for Aug. 19, 2026. Bring your own seating; the County describes the August movie nights as free.

cards.entity_name: Schenectady County Outdoor Summer Movie Night at Mabee Farm Historic Site
cards.title: Watch a movie at Mabee Farm
cards.subtitle: Mabee Farm Historic Site, Rotterdam Junction — Aug. 24
cards.notes: Pack a blanket or lawn chairs, arrive early to choose a spot, and enjoy the outdoor screening without needing an admission purchase.
cards.short_summary: A County-sponsored, all-ages outdoor movie night at the historic farm.
cards.evidence_claim: Schenectady County lists its Aug. 24, 2026 outdoor movie night at Mabee Farm Historic Site as free and open to all ages.
cards.source_title: Schenectady County Outdoor Summer Movie Night
cards.access_notes: Aug. 24, 2026, 7:30–9:30 p.m.; the movie begins at 8 p.m. The County says it is free and open to all ages.

cards.title: Listen at Jazz on Jay
cards.subtitle: Jay Square, downtown Schenectady
cards.notes: Meet at Jay Square for a Thursday set, bring a seat if you want one, and keep the plan simple by skipping purchases from nearby businesses.
cards.short_summary: Free Thursday outdoor jazz concerts in downtown Schenectady through late August.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Jazz on Jay site says its 2026 schedule offers free outdoor concerts at Jay Square in Schenectady.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 series runs Thursdays through Aug. 27 at Jay Square; official site identifies the concerts as free.

cards.title: Catch a Music Haven set
cards.subtitle: Music Haven Stage, Central Park, Schenectady
cards.notes: Check the remaining program, bring a blanket or lawn chair, and make an easy evening of the free outdoor performance in Central Park.
cards.short_summary: A free summer series of music, comedy, film, and community events in Central Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Music Haven states that its 2026 Summer Series in Schenectady’s Central Park is a free season running July 12 through Aug. 28.
cards.access_notes: The stated 2026 season runs through Aug. 28; review the program for the remaining dates and weather updates.

cards.entity_name: Hon. Karen B. Johnson Main Library Meeting Rooms
cards.title: Attend an open library meeting
cards.subtitle: Hon. Karen B. Johnson Main Library, Schenectady
cards.notes: Check the library calendar for an open noncommercial gathering, then use the meeting rooms as a no-admission setting for a social, cultural, or educational event.
cards.short_summary: Public meetings at the County library cannot charge admission or take a collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Schenectady County Public Library says its meeting rooms support social, cultural, and educational activities; qualifying use is free and no admission charge or collection is allowed.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room | Schenectady County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Use the library calendar to find an event open to the public. The room policy prohibits admission charges and collections.
